text: SIBUR Holding's own website lists Kazanorgsintez as 64% held through SIBUR-RT, which SIBUR owns 100%. Kommersant reported in October 2021 that SIBUR had acquired the TAIF holding company, which controlled Kazanorgsintez (64%) and Nizhnekamskneftekhim (83%); TAIF was later renamed SIBUR-RT.
short: Kazanorgsintez is 64% held by SIBUR-RT, which SIBUR owns outright.

source.name: SIBUR: PAO Kazanorgsintez site (subsidiary listing in the SIBUR group site menu)
source.note: Translation: 'Kazanorgsintez (64%) (through SIBUR-RT (100%))'. The SIBUR group site menu lists group assets with SIBUR's stakes.

additionalSources.name: Kommersant-Kazan: СИБУР завершил приобретение ТАИФа ('SIBUR completed the acquisition of TAIF')
additionalSources.quote: «СИБУР холдинг» приобрел АО «ТАИФ», контролирующее «Нижнекамскнефтехим» (83% от уставного капитала), «Казаньоргсинтез» (64%) и генерирующую компанию ТГК-16 (100%)
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'SIBUR Holding acquired TAIF JSC, which controls Nizhnekamskneftekhim (83% of charter capital), Kazanorgsintez (64%) and generating company TGC-16 (100%).'
